application_fee.details: Application fee is non-refundable and must be paid by candidates through the online link given in the application form via Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card.

qualification.details: Desirable Qualifications and Experience: - Scientist-D (Medical): DQ: MD/MS or equivalent degree recognized by MCI/NMC or MPH from a recognized university or Ph.D. from a recognized University in a subject related to Biomedical sciences. DE: Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to job requirements i.e. Epidemiology of Non-Communicable Diseases, Public Health and Health Systems in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions. - Scientist-D (Non-Medical): DQ: Ph.D. from a recognized University in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences. DE: Experience in Research & Development relevant to job requirements i.e. Biostatistics / Data Sciences in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions. | Experience Notes: 1. PhD will be considered as 4 years’ experience (irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree). 2. MD/MS or equivalent to be considered as 3 years’ experience. 3. MVSc will be considered as 2 years' experience. 4. MPH/M. Tech/ME will not be considered as any experience. 5. Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to the job requirements in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions will be admissible. 6. The period spent on obtaining minimum essential educational qualification shall not count towards experience.

selection_process: The selection would be made based on a computer-based test (MCQs) or interview or both. The computer-based test
would be based on the understanding of research methods and will be of qualifying nature.
Shortlisting Criteria: In the first instance
all candidates fulfilling minimum eligibility in respect of age
and experience shall be shortlisted. If the number of shortlisted candidates is high
ICMR shall further shortlist candidates based on suitable criteria fixed by the Competent Authority
such as higher experience or higher educational qualifications.
how_to_apply: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://recruitment.icmr.org.in and complete the online registration.
Log in using the User ID and password received on your registered email ID and mobile number.
Click on the 'Go to Application Form' button and fill out the section-wise application form carefully.

Upload scanned copies of self-attested/attested certificates and documents in support of educational qualifications from matric onwards, detailed marks certificates, date of birth, category certificates, MCI registration certificate, and experience certificates.
Upload your unattested photograph following the prescribed instructions (no cap or goggles; spectacles are allowed).
Click submit and proceed to pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1,500/- through Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card.
Take a final printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Applicants working in Central/State Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings, or Government-funded research agencies must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of personal discussion with an undertaking that they will be relieved within one month of receipt of the appointment order. Applications received after the closing date or incomplete applications without supportive documents will be rejected. Relevant documents of educational qualification, specialization, and experience as claimed must be invariably uploaded. Any outside influence brought in by or on behalf of a candidate shall disqualify him/her. Candidates must regularly visit the ICMR website www.icmr.nic.in for updates. ICMR retains the liberty to modify, cancel, or publish afresh the vacancy circular, and vacancies are provisional and may vary.

content_sections.heading: ICMR Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available under this recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: ICMR Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualifications and Experience: - Scientist-D (Medical): DQ: MD/MS or equivalent degree recognized by MCI/NMC or MPH from a recognized university or Ph.D. from a recognized University in a subject related to Biomedical sciences. DE: Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to job requirements i.e. Epidemiology of Non-Communicable Diseases, Public Health and Health Systems in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions. - Scientist-D (Non-Medical): DQ: Ph.D. from a recognized University in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences. DE: Experience in Research & Development relevant to job requirements i.e. Biostatistics / Data Sciences in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions. Experience Notes: 1. PhD will be considered as 4 years’ experience (irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree). 2. MD/MS or equivalent to be considered as 3 years’ experience. 3. MVSc will be considered as 2 years' experience. 4. MPH/M. Tech/ME will not be considered as any experience. 5. Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to the job requirements in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions will be admissible. 6. content_sections.text: Upper age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable in accordance with Government of India instructions.

content_sections.heading: ICMR Salary
content_sections.text: Usual allowances as admissible to ICMR employees are applicable.

rows.pay_level_pay: Level 12 of Pay Matrix (Rs. 78,800-2,09,200) (7th CPC Scale)

content_sections.heading: ICMR Application Fee
content_sections.text: Application fee is non-refundable and must be paid by candidates through the online link given in the application form via Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card.

content_sections.heading: ICMR Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection would be made based on a computer-based test (MCQs) or interview or both. The computer-based test, if conducted, would be based on the understanding of research methods and will be of qualifying nature. Shortlisting Criteria: In the first instance, all candidates fulfilling minimum eligibility in respect of age, educational qualifications, and experience shall be shortlisted. If the number of shortlisted candidates is high, ICMR shall further shortlist candidates based on suitable criteria fixed by the Competent Authority, ICMR, such as higher experience or higher educational qualifications.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR Recruitment
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://recruitment.icmr.org.in and complete the online registration. Log in using the User ID and password received on your registered email ID and mobile number. Click on the 'Go to Application Form' button and fill out the section-wise application form carefully. Upload scanned copies of self-attested/attested certificates and documents in support of educational qualifications from matric onwards, detailed marks certificates, date of birth, category certificates, MCI registration certificate, and experience certificates. Upload your unattested photograph following the prescribed instructions (no cap or goggles; spectacles are allowed). Click submit and proceed to pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1,500/- through Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card. Take a final printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certificates and detailed marks sheets in support of educational qualifications from Matric onwards Date of birth proof Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS) if applicable MCI/NMC registration certificate (for Medical stream) Experience certificates issued by the Competent Authority indicating duration (start and end dates), pay level, work profile, and other relevant details Final degree certificate evidencing essential and desirable qualifications Scanned photograph and signature

content_sections.heading: ICMR Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applicants working in Central/State Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings, or Government-funded research agencies must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of personal discussion with an undertaking that they will be relieved within one month of receipt of the appointment order. Applications received after the closing date or incomplete applications without supportive documents will be rejected. Relevant documents of educational qualification, specialization, and experience as claimed must be invariably uploaded. Any outside influence brought in by or on behalf of a candidate shall disqualify him/her. Candidates must regularly visit the ICMR website www.icmr.nic.in for updates. ICMR retains the liberty to modify, cancel, or publish afresh the vacancy circular, and vacancies are provisional and may vary.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ICMR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies are available for the Scientist-D post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ICMR Scientist-D posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 16 November 2026 till 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification for Scientist-D (Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS or equivalent degree recognized by MCI/NMC along with 8 years of essential experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Scientist-D (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Masters degree from a recognized University in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences or a Pharm-D degree recognized by UGC/PCI, along with 8 years of essential experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years, with relaxations applicable in accordance with Government of India instructions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for ICMR Scientist-D recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,500/- for general candidates, while SC, ST, Women, PWBD, and EWS candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for Scientist-D positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in Level 12 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 78,800-2,09,200) under the 7th CPC Scale with usual allowances.

faq.question: Q9. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: The selection is made based on a computer-based test (MCQs) or interview or both.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates submit their online applications?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal at https://recruitment.icmr.org.in.
